basis: Annual salary or wage income before tax, in whole Australian dollars, as reported at the 'Salary or wages' label of 2023-24 individual income tax returns (returns processed by 31 October 2025), grouped by the main salary-and-wage occupation code on the return. p50 is the published median and mean the published average, both for persons (the source's 'Total' row) and both calculated by the ATO over individuals whose salary or wages were not zero. This covers everyone who lodged with that occupation, whatever their hours: full-time, part-time, casual and part-year workers are all included, so it is not a full-time-only figure. The amounts are already annual, so no weekly-to-annual conversion was applied; the only change is rounding to whole dollars (half up). 'employees' is the number of individuals who lodged a return with that occupation code. p10, p25, p75 and p90 are null because the source does not publish them.

source.name: Australian Taxation Office, Taxation statistics 2023-24, Individuals Table 15A (pay and counts); ATO Salary and Wage Occupation Codes, 2023-24 sheet (aliases)
